2006.why: It drew about one and a half times the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about electrical. 2006 is one of the weaker years of a model that usually draws somewhat fewer complaints than the average car.
2006.pln: about one and a half times the average car's complaints
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Lights
Walk around with the lights on: headlights, taillights, brake lights and turn signals.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.

2007.why: It drew about three-quarters as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about electrical.
2007.pln: about three-quarters as many complaints as the average car
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Airbags
The airbag light should come on at start, then go out and stay out.
Lights
Walk around with the lights on: headlights, taillights, brake lights and turn signals.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.

2008.why: It drew about half as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about electrical.
2008.pln: about half as many complaints as the average car
td: Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
Brakes
Brake firmly once at speed: it should stop straight, with no pulsing, grinding or brake warning light.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Fuel system
Watch for hard starts, stalling, hesitation or a fuel smell.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Lights
Walk around with the lights on: headlights, taillights, brake lights and turn signals.
Seat belts
Every belt should latch and retract.
Doors & locks
Lock and unlock every door from the fob and the switch, and open each one.

2010.why: It drew a bit under half as many complaints as the average car in its first 3 years, most about seats.
2010.pln: a bit under half as many complaints as the average car
td: Seats
Adjust each seat, try any heaters, and make sure they lock in place.
Speed control
It should accelerate and hold speed smoothly, with no surging; try the cruise control.
Body
Look underneath for rust, and check the doors, hood and hatch close and latch right.
Shifting
From a stop and on the highway: no slipping, flaring revs, harsh or late shifts, or shudder.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
